title: Beethoven: the exposition, twice
question: How do the opening pauses feel the second time?
intro: Three short Gs land on a held E♭, then three Fs on a held D. At the repeat sign, Beethoven sends the orchestra back through all 124 bars: the pauses, the horn call and the quiet violin tune in E♭ major.
listenFor: The held E♭ and D stop the opening in its tracks on each pass, before the strings set off again.

sources.title: Mutopia 941: Beethoven, Symphony No. 5, first movement — Breitkopf and Härtel, 1862–65
LilyPond orchestral sources: every part encloses bars 1–124 in the same two-pass repeat, with no alternative ending
